result.evidence_quote: we aimed to investigate the potential pro-inflammatory effects of sterile fecal microbiome filtrate (FMF) using a microphysiological, immunocompetent intestine-on-chip (IoC) model.
result.rationale: The study examines intestinal inflammation, barrier integrity, and immune responses in ulcerative colitis. It does not investigate brain or neural mechanisms, cognition, neurological injury, or treatments or biomarkers for neurological disorders.
